description: This source file implements a service class `WatchMessagingService` for managing communication between an iOS app and an Apple Watch app via the WatchConnectivity framework. It includes error handling, status management, message sending, reply handling, and delegate implementation.

classes.name: WatchMessagingService
classes.description: A singleton class managing messaging between iOS and Apple Watch using WCSession, providing methods to check support, send notifications, handle replies, and manage session state.

methods.name: isSupportedOnDevice
methods.description: Checks if WatchConnectivity is supported on the current device.

methods.name: currentStatusSnapshot
methods.description: Returns a snapshot of the current watch messaging status.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current watch messaging status.

methods.name: setReplyHandler
methods.description: Sets a callback to handle quick reply events received from the watch.

methods.name: sendNotification
methods.description: Sends a notification to the watch with specified parameters, handling both immediate and queued delivery based on reachability.

methods.name: ensureActivated
methods.description: Ensures that the WCSession is activated before performing messaging operations.
